description: STT evaluation samples. Every reference_text below was authored (or, for 'fixture' samples, already documented in apps/api/tests/fixtures/README.md) strictly before and independently of any faster-whisper run - reference transcripts are never generated from the model under test. 'fixture' samples reuse an existing, already-verified test-audio file synthesized via macOS `say` (a completely different, non-neural TTS engine than the app's own TTS provider). 'synthesize_at_eval_time' samples are synthesized fresh at evaluation time using the Phase 5 LocalHfTtsProvider (facebook/mms-tts-eng) from the reference_text, with a fixed torch random seed for reproducibility - this is real synthetic speech audio, not human-recorded speech, and that limitation is deliberate and documented (see docs/evaluation.md): it lets this evaluation run in any environment with no external audio corpus, at the honest cost of not measuring real human-speech accuracy.
